checks.title: Public application readiness
checks.expected: The public application and bounded capability pack are ready.
checks.observed: Public readiness completed with all required checks available.

checks.title: Architect application identity
checks.expected: The operator session resolves to an active architect identity.
checks.observed: An active architect identity was authenticated through the application plane.

checks.title: Independent reviewer identity
checks.expected: A distinct active reviewer identity is available.
checks.observed: A distinct reviewer identity was authenticated and separated from the architect.

checks.title: Logical human boundary
checks.expected: A normal human is created without host or database bindings.
checks.observed: The human identity remained logical-only with no runtime binding.

checks.title: Agent effective policy
checks.expected: The agent may read approved department memory but may not write canonical memory.
checks.observed: Effective policy allowed bounded reuse and explicitly denied canonical writes.

checks.title: Confirmed provisioning gate
checks.expected: Agent provisioning requires a queued plan and explicit revision confirmation.
checks.observed: A revision-gated plan completed through the bounded provisioner.

checks.title: Dedicated Linux UID boundary
checks.expected: The agent runs as a dedicated locked system identity with owned private state.
checks.observed: A dedicated locked system identity and private ownership boundary were verified.

checks.title: Protected resource read denial
checks.expected: The agent cannot read application, source, or model-authentication resources.
checks.observed: All protected read probes were denied by the host boundary.

checks.title: Private workspace write allowance
checks.expected: The agent can write its private persistent workspace.
checks.observed: The private workspace write probe succeeded.

checks.title: Bounded agent service
checks.expected: The dedicated agent service runs under its expected identity with no-new-privileges and IP sockets denied.
checks.observed: The active dedicated process had no-new-privileges, an available broker socket, and a denied IP-socket probe.
checks.enforcement: Service manager sandbox and runtime socket probe

checks.title: Direct database connection denial
checks.expected: The agent process cannot connect directly to the database.
checks.observed: The agent direct-connection probe was denied.

checks.title: Canonical data mutation denial
checks.expected: The restricted public data client cannot mutate canonical memory.
checks.observed: A real canonical mutation probe was rejected.

checks.title: Restricted data and row-policy boundary
checks.expected: The public data client is least-privileged and sensitive identity tables force row policy.
checks.observed: Least privilege and forced row-policy controls were verified.

checks.title: Brokered capability reuse
checks.expected: The agent receives only an approved capability with provenance through the broker.
checks.observed: The broker allowed one governed capability and returned source provenance.

checks.title: Quarantined upload boundary
checks.expected: Uploaded material remains quarantined before independent review.
checks.observed: The upload hash was verified, sealed read-only, and produced a review-pending candidate.

checks.title: Candidate public isolation
checks.expected: A quarantined candidate is absent from public capability retrieval.
checks.observed: The candidate-specific public search returned no match.

checks.title: Independent candidate review
checks.expected: A reviewer distinct from the architect approves the candidate for draft promotion.
checks.observed: The independent reviewer approved the candidate for draft promotion.

checks.title: Architect draft promotion
checks.expected: Only an architect can promote the reviewed candidate, and only as a draft.
checks.observed: The architect promotion produced a governed draft, not canonical memory.

checks.title: Draft public isolation
checks.expected: The promoted draft remains absent from public canonical retrieval.
checks.observed: The draft-specific public search still returned no match.

checks.title: Application and policy revocation
checks.expected: Suspension removes all effective agent permissions.
checks.observed: The suspended identity had no effective permissions.

checks.title: Host runtime revocation
checks.expected: Suspension stops the service and removes its broker credential files and group access.
checks.observed: The service stopped and host credential access was removed.

checks.title: Broker credential revocation
checks.expected: A credential captured before suspension is rejected afterward.
checks.observed: The broker rejected the pre-suspension credential.
